audience: field-service companies that plan jobs, visits and invoices in Mobile Field Report

useCases.title: Plan the week's appointments
useCases.text: List appointments with their start and end times, filtered by date. Open one appointment to read its contacts.

useCases.title: Count and list open service requests
useCases.text: Count the service requests that match a filter, then list them with their state and customer.

useCases.title: Find invoices with an open balance
useCases.text: List the invoices with their due date and open balance. Open one invoice to read its customer and dunning records.

useCases.title: Check the time booked on a job
useCases.text: Read a service request, then list its time events with the work time, approval and state of each event.

useCases.title: Add an internal comment to a job
useCases.text: Read the comments of a service request, then add one comment. Set it internal to keep it visible to staff only.
